```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

script_dir <- "flux-processing/R"
base_dir   <- "flux-processing/data/fluxes/gc-raw"          # <-- IMPORTANT: this is the run-folder tree
tidy_root  <- "flux-processing/data/tidy"

# Source the batch runner + dependencies it needs
source(file.path(script_dir, "logging_helpers.R"))
source(file.path(script_dir, "normalize_gc_filename_one.R"))
source(file.path(script_dir, "extract_gc_run_date_from_txt.R"))
source(file.path(script_dir, "get_peak_heights_from_file.R"))
source(file.path(script_dir, "process_gc_run.R"))
source(file.path(script_dir, "run_all_gc.R"))

normalize_gc_filename <- function(x) vapply(x, normalize_gc_filename_one, character(1))
```

# Step 1: Extract peak heights


```{r step1-one-date}
# ---- RUN STEP 1 for ONE run folder ----
run_dir <- "flux-processing/data/fluxes/gc-raw/2022/8.12.22"   # <-- change to your real folder
process_gc_run(run_dir = run_dir, tidy_root = tidy_root)
```

# Step 2: Convert heights to ppm

```{r step2}
run_step02_all_dates(
  tidy_root    = tidy_root,
  overwrite    = overwrite,
  verbose      = TRUE,
  date_filter  = run_label

```

Outputs written

	•	tidy/<YYMMDD>/<YYMMDD>_ghg_ppm.csv
